summary: The complete fixed-Brown57 ten-deletion lower bound is supported by the reviewed mathematics and completed exact finite checks. One cosmetic dependency sentence was corrected and re-read; no open proof gap remains. Assurance is same-family/provisional, not formal verification.

scope.canonical_statement: For every finite simple undirected graph G on {0,...,56} union {x}, if maximum degree(G)<=8 and diameter(G)<=2, and B is the supplied Brown57 graph, then |E(B) minus E(G)|>=10 and the number of added old-old edges equals |E(B) minus E(G)|.

obligations.statement: Concrete input is the 57-vertex simple Brown graph
obligations.justification: Independently checked 224 distinct ordered pairs u<v, labels 0..56, and equality with the displayed F7 orthogonality rule.
Independent reconstruction gives sizes 8,21,28; C degree 7 with neighbors only E; other degrees 8; E has two C and three I neighbors; I has four I neighbors.

1+7+7*7=57 forces every candidate degree to be 8; candidate has 232 edges, x has 8, so 224 old-old edges and equal old deletion/addition counts.

obligations.justification: 58 <= 65-2*t(v) gives t(v)<=3, while every old I vertex starts in four. Added edges cannot remove surviving triangles.

Seven triangles partition I; sigma<=1, e<=1, retained C coverage <=e, j<=1; I upper bound <=7.

a+b<=9 and 3a+b>=21 imply 6<=a<=9. At a=8 choose eight base III edges and one extra of one of four actual edge types; a=9 is all II.

Equality forces six disjoint III blocks and three IEE blocks at missing vertices. The missing triple is an III triangle in each of14 families; external neighbor sets are disjoint, so deletions form a matching and S must dominate the original graph.

Each family has a unique central triangle on both repeated vertices; six remaining triangles disjoint. Extras occupy two disjoint five-point blocks at the missing vertices. Three central choices yield9+3+3=15 fixed cases; only fixed repeated endpoints carry spare weight.

Two partitions; extras pool203=21+56+84+42. Every actual deletion set has a representation. Fix at most two affected base triangles excluding extra edges. Independent enumeration gives145040 cases and verifies known/unknown disjointness and total spare<=3.

obligations.statement: Candidate and block coverage of the C++ searches
obligations.justification: C and all possible positive-deficit vertices are included; known weights exact, unknown blocks weight0. At most two per block; five-point blocks additionally enforce original adjacency. Each genuine S obeys all restrictions.

For a putative successful S*, maintain chosen subset S* and ignored targets outside its known retained closed neighborhood. Select its first available target dominator, or ignore a target truly uncovered by S*. Excluding earlier dominators loses no such path. M bounds its final uncovered count.

Candidate count and largest individual gains give optimistic bounds. The witness path has sufficient remaining ignore budget. Empty unignored target set still branches to eight selections. Leaves use real uncovered/spare counts and cover21 adds h. Every recursive step increases selection depth or ignored count.
Fresh compilation and one-CPU runs finish with a6:14/1189/zero; a7-19:42/630/107074/zero; a7-21:2/145040/5805357/zero, complete=1. Node arrays and normalized type counts match author JSON.

III union covers21; base spare<=3 and CE gives at most1 at C. sigma<=4,e<=1, retained C coverage<=e, hence j<=4. With sigma=D-j+epsilon_C, I bound=3j+3e+epsilon_C<=16.

obligations.justification: Cases r<=7,r=8,r=9 are exhausted. All dependencies are read and discharged by local mathematics plus explicit completed finite checks; no arbitrary-order58 nonexistence inference.

issues.statement_before: every Brown edge belongs to one triangle
issues.why_invalid: The 56 CE edges belong to no triangle. The particular edge mm' is II and belongs to one, so the argument is unaffected; its stated at-most-one premise already suffices.

issues.resolution: Fixed by the parent/author during this audit; reviewer re-read line27 and confirmed the exact correction. No proof or computation changed.
